name: Longmeadow, MA
tagline: A close-knit Jewish community in the Pioneer Valley, a couple of hours from Boston, Hartford and New York.
about: Springfield/Longmeadow offers affordable residential neighborhoods and small-city amenities, with an active JCC, a Modern Orthodox synagogue, Chabad, youth groups and a strong STEM reputation. Area Jewish day schools offer tuition support to community families.

schools.name: Heritage Academy
schools.note: Community day school open to families across the spectrum of observance; secular and Judaic studies.

schools.name: Lubavitcher Yeshiva Academy
schools.note: Chabad-Lubavitch day school; NEASC-accredited. Part of Lubavitch of Greater Springfield, which also runs a preschool and Hebrew school.
